notes.title: Update 1.0.0d
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]

[*]     Added 95 new plants
[*]     Modified all plant seed growth and drop rates to reflect early access timing
[*]     Changed the start menu to say "Early Access" instead of "Demo"
[*]     Removed the pop-up blurb explaining that growth times are reduced for demo purposes
[*]     Fixed a major bug that would prevent the player inventory from resetting correctly after wiping data
[*]     Added subtyping frames and new icons
[*]     Added Reroll button for final alchemy card
[*]     Added Reroll feedback via particles
[*]     Inventory now closes when moving to a new room
[*]     Changed text in main game scene to say Plantasia Early Access instead of Demo
[*]     Fixed taskbar making the game go off the screen when adjusting window size
[*]     Added unique dialogue sound effects for each character
[*]     Adjusted the layout of the request board UI
[*]     Minor animation bug fixes for dialogue boxes
[*]     Added progression gates to prevent interaction with systems that haven't been introduced
[*]     Revised all dialogue for better pacing
[*]     Fixed base resource drops
[*]     Hide plant info if the seed is not known from inventory menu
[*]     Fixed seed info icon aspect ratio to fit with new seed size
[*]     Added 2 seeds with a 30% chance to drop 3 on a harvest
[*]     Reworked UI for the audio information in top right
[*]     Added hover states for status icons on planters
[*]     Fixed scroll bar on inventory being disabled
[*]     Readjusted arrow sizes and spacing for inventory tab menu
[*]     Added hover effects to the Play and Reset Data buttons on the Start Menu
[*]     Adjusted the text box widths for characters so they don't overlap with the UI background elements
[*]     Fixed cannot hit Play from the main menu after going back from the main game scene
[*]     Players can now scroll the tab bar at the top of their inventory using the mouse wheel
[*]     Expanded the yellow border around the reroll confirmation panel for the REVIVE requests
[*]     Made the "Turn Off the Lights" screen reflect the new three starter planters instead of six
[*]     Changed layout of music information in top right corner
[*]     Decreased grow times for all plants
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #2 - 0.8.9.2
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is at an end - but Plantasia is only beginning! We have received lots of community feedback about bugs, questions, and new features. We are committed to improving the Demo alongside the full game throughout development, and the Demo will remain live permanently.

Plantasia goes into Early Access in late March - so stay tuned!

[list]
[*] options menu anchor fixed
[*] Seed Bundle Request menu should work more smoothly
[*] Seed Bundle Requests no longer require specific plant colors without telling us
[*] Seed Colors are now present in the Seed Bundle Allocation menu
[*] Seed Bundle Alocation menus now close automatically when opening another Allocation menu
[*] Fixed MacKenna's dialogue after completing the first Seed Bundle Request
[*] Made good progress on stopping the Request Menu from crashing out when you complete one (not done yet but much closer)
[*] Removed console box that popped up in background for some machines
[*] Removed dev log that popped after planting seeds
[/list]

We are still working on a number of improvements daily! If you encounter bugs or have general feedback, please join our Discord and post your suggestions in the #community-feedback channel. Our developers are very active and can update you on upcoming changes.

Please join us this afternoon our Discord for a short Livestream with our Creative Director, Ayla to go over the newest updates. 3pm PST, March 3rd!

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes #1 - 0.8.9.1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Plantasia during the first three days of Steam Next Fest! We have received lots of community feedback about bugs, questions, and new features. We are committed to improving the Demo alongside the full game throughout development - but certainly during Next Fest. 


New Features:
[list]
[*] Made seed bank spin on loop in the seed bank
[*] Added particle effect around plants when ready to harvest
[/list]

What has been fixed?
[list]
[*] Fixed scaling issues appearing on screens other than 1920x1080. All screens, including ultra wides, should fit Plantasia normally.
[*] Fixed an issue where seed in the inventory appeared outside the inventory box after scrolling
[*] Reduced the number of times a plant will generate a Growth Trigger 
[*] fixed an issue where plants in pots were not saved when closing and reopening Plantasia
[*] Max inventory count is now removed
[*] Fixed sub filtering on greenhouse and seed request inventories
[*] Redid seed bank room completely to work with the widescreen change
[*] Seed Bundle Request system refresh fixes and changes
[*] Plants planted in a planter not loading from save images fixed (new plants only)
[*] Multiple minor Adjustments to request bundle (grid layout, autoselect/deselect)
[*] No more spamming rewards from the Seed Bundle Requests
[*] Patched bug where inventory UI wasn't updating when a request was completed
[*] UI adjustments to NPC Dialogue (response highlighted buttons brightened)
[/list]

We are still working on a number of improvements daily! If you encounter bugs or have general feedback, please join our Discord and post your suggestions in the #community-feedback channel. Our developers are very active and can update you on upcoming changes.

Please join us tonight on the Steam Page or in our Discord for a Live Birthday Stream with our Creative Director, Ayla at 6pm PST, February 26th!

notes.title: Plantasia Demo Now Available
notes.content:
From February 24th through March 3rd, a demo version of Plantasia will be available to play for free on Steam!

It has been 10 long months of development. We started as a tiny group of 3 friends and have grown to a fully functioning team of 16 junior developers. We are all very excited to share this amazing passion project with the public!

This demo showcases a full game loop of planting, tending, growing, harvesting, and breeding unique, houseplant-inspired, flora.

You begin with 2 different seeds and 6 open pots to grow them. Throughout the demo you will experience:

- 3 NPCs
- various Seed Bundle requests and rewards
- an introduction to the overall story
- a full 26 song original soundtrack
- the Greenhouse and Crafting rooms
- 6 base seeds
- numerous unique hybrid combinations
- 1 crafting recipe

Our full game will have MUCH more to discover!

Plantasia is still in active development, but we can promise you will be able to experience more of Plantasia, outside this demo, soon. 

In order to make the best game possible - we need your help! As you play Plantasia’s demo you may notice that somethings aren’t working how you expect, or wishing for a feature that does not exist. We plead you to share these thoughts with us - the team!

Feedback is extremely important for game developers to understand how you, the player, feel about the game and how you would like to see it improve. You can share your feedback with us directly, through our [url=https://discord.gg/e7meFZrBUn]Discord Server[/url] in the #community-feedback channel.

You can find us on nearly all other socials through our [url=https://linktr.ee/cavebeargames]Linktree[/url].

Thank you for participating in our demo! We cannot wait to share more with you.

The Cave Bear Games Team
